replies.author: LeCobalt
replies.body:
ABOUT THE LAG

I thought of this before when I was laying out the town it.
Orginal schematics had item frames, flower pots, trapdoors, and all of those fancy hitbox blocks. I actually reduced the houses so they're:
  • Empty on the inside
  • You can't enter them
  • The most complex hit-box they have is a fence 
  • Lighting is not a problem because I actually sealed off most of the houses so no light is emitted from them

The town was made for an OVERKILL aesthetic feature that interferes 0% in your gameplay.
The map isn't big, I can load the entire thing in ~16 chunk setting and the pvp area in just 8-12

I get ~300 fps with the entire map loaded on a 32 based texture pack


WHAT DO I DO IF I FALL?

You can't.

There's a yml feature that tps you if you are closer than 28 blocks to the surface

replies.author: LeCobalt
replies.body:
Have you tried allocating a bit more ram to MC?

I highly suggest that, before I got ~5 fps, I later allocated 4-8 GB's and I can run 60fps shaders

If you are already out of ram I suggest installing optifine and going to it's setting and changing them to default, that gave me a 300% improvement


If you are in a truly doubt on the fps you'd get on this map, then I suggest downloading it:D
